description: Agent-based, network-structured simulation of mask adoption dynamics under social influence, information campaigns, supply constraints, and policy enforcement, with integrated epidemiological transmission to estimate downstream effects.

parameters.credibility_distribution: Beta(3,2) for pro/neutral; Beta(2,3) for anti

modules.name: SocialInfluenceModule
modules.description: Updates person beliefs (risk perception, perceived benefits/costs, compliance propensity) from peer and social network mask-wearing norms.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  neighbors = social_neighbors(i)
  observed_rate = mean(mask_wearing_state[n] over neighbors in last observation_window_days)
  homophily_weighted_rate = weighted_mean(observed_rate, weight = 1 + homophily_by_age_strength*similarity(age_i, age_n))
  norm_signal = sigmoid(peer_norm_sensitivity_beta * (homophily_weighted_rate - 0.5))
  delta_benefit = social_influence_weight * susceptibility_to_influence[i] * norm_signal
  delta_cost = -0.5 * social_influence_weight * susceptibility_to_influence[i] * (1 - norm_signal)
  perceived_benefit[i] = clip(perceived_benefit[i] + delta_benefit, 0, 1)
  perceived_cost[i] = clip(perceived_cost[i] + delta_cost, 0, 1)
  compliance_propensity[i] = clip(0.5*compliance_propensity[i] + 0.5*perceived_benefit[i] - 0.3*perceived_cost[i], 0, 1)
  emit signal.norm_perception_updates[i]
notes: Homophily emphasizes influence from similar-age peers.

modules.name: HouseholdNormsModule
modules.description: Diffuses norms within households and shares mask inventory among members.

notes: Household norms reinforce perceived benefit and reduce perceived cost when household average is pro-mask.

modules.name: InformationCampaignModule
modules.description: Applies authority messaging and information sources to update information_state, trust, and perceived benefits/costs.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day % authority_campaign_frequency_days == 0:
  for each person i:
    authority_signal = authority_message_credibility * authority_message_reach * information_campaign_effect
    belief_shift = authority_trust_weight * trust_in_authority[i] * authority_signal
    perceived_benefit[i] = clip(perceived_benefit[i] + belief_shift, 0, 1)
    perceived_cost[i] = clip(perceived_cost[i] - 0.5*belief_shift, 0, 1)
    information_state[i] = min(1.0, information_state[i] + belief_shift)
  
for each info_source s:
  if day % broadcast_frequency(s) == 0:
    for each person i (sample by reach of s):
      orientation = +1 for pro, 0 for neutral, -1 for anti
      noise = Bernoulli(misinformation_rate) ? -1 : 1
      delta = orientation * avg_info_source_credibility * noise * 0.05
      perceived_benefit[i] = clip(perceived_benefit[i] + delta, 0, 1)
      perceived_cost[i] = clip(perceived_cost[i] - delta*0.5, 0, 1)
      update trust_in_authority[i] slightly toward authority_message_credibility (bounded)
      emit signal.information_belief_updates[i]
notes: Authority campaigns occur at fixed frequency; sources broadcast by reach subset sampling.

modules.name: MaskSupplyModule
modules.description: Maintains retailer inventory, restocking, pricing, and processes purchase attempts by persons.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each retailer r:
  r.stock_level += retailer_restock_rate_per_day / retailers_count
  if r.stock_level <= 0: mask_shortage_flag_today = 1

for each person i scheduled to purchase (every purchase_interval_days, or mask_owned[i] < min_masks_per_person_target):
  demand = max(0, min_masks_per_person_target - mask_owned[i])
  affordability = 1 / (1 + price_elasticity_of_demand * max(0, mask_price / (income[i]/365)))
  qty = min(max_purchase_per_customer, floor(demand * affordability))
  assign retailer r with available stock; purchase qty' = min(qty, r.stock_level)
  r.stock_level -= qty'; mask_owned[i] += qty'
  if qty > qty' (stockout): trust_in_authority[i] = max(0, trust_in_authority[i] - stockout_penalty_to_trust)

emit observable.mask_shortage_flag = mask_shortage_flag_today
notes: Stock is evenly restocked across retailers; purchase cadence and affordability constrain buying.

modules.name: MobilityAndContactModule
modules.description: Moves persons to locations and samples effective contacts per location type.

notes: Contacts are sampled stochastically by location type multipliers and capacities.

modules.name: PolicyEnforcementModule
modules.description: Enforces mask mandates at locations after mandate activation; may deny entry or fine non-compliant persons.

notes: Inspection rate implicitly incorporated in enforcement_probability and location enforcement_level.

modules.name: AdoptionDecisionModule
modules.description: Decides daily mask-wearing state based on perceived benefits/costs, fatigue, enforcement deterrence, and resource availability.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  deterrence = enforcement_deterrence_weight * min(1, enforcement_history[i].fines / 100.0)
  utility = perceived_benefit_weight*perceived_benefit[i] - perceived_cost_weight*perceived_cost[i] - adherence_fatigue[i] + deterrence
  affordability_penalty = income_cost_sensitivity * max(0, (mask_price > income[i]/365))
  p_comply = clip(base_compliance_probability + utility - affordability_penalty, 0, 1)
  if mask_owned[i] <= 0: p_comply *= 0.1
  mask_wearing_state[i] = Bernoulli(p_comply)
  adherence_fatigue[i] = clip(adherence_fatigue[i] + fatigue_increment_per_day*(mask_wearing_state[i]?1:0) - fatigue_recovery_rate*(mask_wearing_state[i]?0:1), 0, 1)
  emit signal.mask_use_decisions_today[i]
notes: Fatigue increases when wearing, decays slowly when not wearing; deterrence increases utility to comply.

modules.name: DiseaseTransmissionModule
modules.description: Simulates infection transmission over sampled contacts considering mask efficacy for source and wearer, and background importations.

notes: Day-level SEIR-like progression; Cori estimator window size controlled by Rt_sampling_window_days.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates mask adoption statistics overall and by location type and income decile.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate_daily = mean(mask_wearing_state)
adoption_by_location_type = {
  'work': mean(mask_wearing_state among persons scheduled at work today),
  'school': mean(... at school),
  'public': mean(... at public_space)
}
quantize incomes into 10 deciles; compute mean mask_wearing_state per decile
emit observables accordingly
notes: Uses today's schedules to stratify adoption by location type.

modules.name: EpiMetricsAggregator
modules.description: Maintains cumulative infections and computes Rt over a rolling window.

update_rule.pseudocode:
cumulative_infections += observable.infections_daily
emit observable.cumulative_infections
// baseline_infections_daily may be loaded from data for evaluation of cases averted
emit observable.baseline_infections_daily = data.counterfactual[day]
notes: The baseline series is provided from data to compute cases averted; not produced endogenously.

observables.formula_or_field: 1 if any retailer stock_level == 0 today else 0

algorithms.network_generation: Watts–Strogatz small-world graph (networkx.watts_strogatz_graph) with average_degree and rewiring_probability.
algorithms.social_norm_update: DeGroot-style averaging of neighbor states with logistic transformation and homophily weighting.
algorithms.information_persuasion: Weighted belief update combining authority credibility*reach and stochastic broadcasts from sources with misinformation probability.
algorithms.mask_purchase_decision: Utility and affordability-based quantity choice with purchase caps and stock constraints.
algorithms.mobility_and_contacts: Daily schedule assignment with adherence and work-from-home adjustments; Poisson contact sampling per location type.
algorithms.policy_enforcement: Bernoulli inspections leading to deny-entry or fines; events logged for metrics.
algorithms.adoption_decision: Probabilistic compliance via logistic-like utility including perceived benefit/cost, fatigue, deterrence, and resource availability.
algorithms.transmission: Pairwise Bernoulli transmission modified multiplicatively by mask source control and wearer protection; SEIR-like progression discretized by day.
algorithms.Rt_estimation: Cori method over a sliding window of Rt_sampling_window_days.
algorithms.aggregation: Daily group-by computations for adoption and income deciles; cumulative sums for infections and events.
